name: What happens after a roof leak inspection?

mainEntity.name: What happens after a roof leak inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: After completing the inspection, our technician will provide you with a detailed report outlining the identified issues, their probable causes, and recommended repair solutions. This report will include photographs and a clear explanation of the findings. We will then discuss the repair options with you and provide a transparent estimate for the necessary work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Following the inspection, you will receive a detailed report with findings, photos, and a clear explanation of recommended repair options and an estimate.
